newsitem.title: FRANCE: Rain settles over France, more to come - forecasters.
newsitem.headline: Rain settles over France, more to come - forecasters.

text.p: Cloud cover and scattered showers were expected to settle on Monday over France, where crops badly need moisture after a prolonged dry spell, forecasters said.
Meteo France said wet and cooler weather might last until Thursday.
"The forecast is unsettled weather across France on Monday with more rain over the next few days," one forecaster said.
Meteo France said Sunday's and Monday's rain would bring 10-20 millimetres across the country.

On Monday scattered showers moved to eastern France, mostly toward the Alps. Rain was also forecast in the southwest, with wet weather expected to reach the Paris basin and Normandy area in the afternoon.
Rain was expected in France's southwest, north and east on Tuesday, with possible thunderstorms over mountainous areas of the Pyrenees, Massif Central and the Alps.

Temperatures will reach 15-17 degrees in the north and 22 degrees in the south on Monday but will be below normal for spring by Wednesday with 12-13 degrees for the north and 15-17 degrees for the south, forecasters said.
A brief spell of rain last week brought some relief to parched crops but farmers say more moisture is needed after a three-month dry spell.
